title: I²C 上拉电阻：上升沿由 R × C 决定
summary: Blue Pill 的两个开漏引脚以 100 kHz 模拟两条 I²C 线，各挂 200 pF，一条 10 kΩ 上拉、一条 2.2 kΩ。下降沿都很陡，上升沿却一慢一快。测上升时间、低电平，学会给上拉电阻定一个范围。
concepts: I²C 上拉电阻 I²C pull-up
description: Blue Pill 的两个引脚设成 PWM + 开漏（100 kHz），代替 I²C 的时钟线。总线 A：10 kΩ 上拉到 3V3、200 pF 到 GND；总线 B：2.2 kΩ 上拉、200 pF。开漏引脚只会往下拉，往上只能靠上拉电阻给总线电容充电，所以上升时间 ≈ 2.2·R·C。测两条总线的上升沿、400 kHz 时能爬到多高、低电平时的电压和灌电流，对照 I²C 规范选上拉电阻。

cards.title: 哪条线像鲨鱼鳍？
text: **Blue Pill** 下排的 **3V3** 和 **GND** 脚接到下方电源轨。选两个能输出 PWM 的引脚（例如 **PB6**、**PB7**）当两条“总线”。
总线 A：引脚 → **`10 kΩ`** 到 3V3，再接 **`200 pF`** 到 GND。总线 B 一样，但上拉用 **`2.2 kΩ`**。
两个引脚都设成 **PWM**、**`100 kHz`**、**`50 %`**，勾选**「开漏输出」**。示波器 CH1 看总线 A，CH2 看总线 B。
下降沿都很陡。上升沿呢？哪一条像鲨鱼鳍？

cards.title: 往上只能靠电阻
text: - 开漏引脚（5.6 学过）只会**往下拉**：里面是一个约 40 Ω 的开关接到 GND。要输出高电平，它只是**松手**。
![](fig:pullup)
- 松手以后，只有上拉电阻能把线拉高，而且要先给**总线电容**充电：每个芯片引脚、每段导线都贡献几 pF。这是一次 RC 充电——慢，而且是弯的。往下拉时开关只有几十欧，所以下降沿很陡。
![](fig:edges)
- RC 充电从 10 % 到 90 % 的时间（示波器的“上升时间”）：
- 代入 4.7 kΩ、200 pF：$t_r ≈ 2.2 × 4700 × 200$ pF ≈ 2.07 µs。半个时钟周期比这短得多时，线还没爬到高电平就又被拉下去了，对方永远读到 0。

cards.title: 量上升时间和低电平
text: - 点**「检查我的电路」**。检查还会试 **400 kHz**，以及两个引脚静止在**「输出 低」**和松开时的样子。
- 上升时间用示波器的 **rise** 读数；400 kHz 那题在「属性」里把两个引脚都改成 400 kHz，读总线 A 的最高电压。
- 低电平那两题：两个引脚都设成**「输出 低」**（仍勾选开漏），用万用表量总线 B 对 GND。先预测，再读。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **上拉电阻有一个窗口**：太大，上升太慢（$R ≤ \frac{t_r}{0.85 × C}$，按规范的 30–70 % 时间算）；太小，引脚拉不下来——芯片只保证灌 3 mA 时低电平 ≤ 0.4 V，所以 3.3 V 总线 R ≥ (3.3 − 0.4) / 3 mA ≈ 1 kΩ。
- 经验值：3.3 V、100 kHz、几个模块用 **2.2–4.7 kΩ**；400 kHz 或线长用 **1–2.2 kΩ**。芯片内部约 40 kΩ 的上拉太弱，正式电路一定外接。
- 真实电路里的坑：很多 I²C 模块板上已经带了 4.7 kΩ 上拉，挂五个就等于约 940 Ω 并在一起，低于下限——拆掉多余的。上拉接 **3.3 V**，不要接 5 V。

caption.text: 开漏引脚只是一个接 GND 的开关。开关断开时，只有上拉电阻 R_P 能给总线电容 C 充电。

i18n.en: An open-drain pin is just a switch to GND. With the switch open, only the pull-up R_P can charge the bus capacitance C.

caption.text: 引脚松手以后的上升沿：2.2 kΩ 很快爬到 3.3 V，10 kΩ 慢慢爬，半个周期结束时还没到顶。

i18n.en: The rising edge after the pin lets go: 2.2 kΩ climbs quickly to 3.3 V; 10 kΩ crawls and is still short of the top when the half period ends.

en.title: I²C pull-ups: R × C sets the rising edge
en.summary: Two open-drain Blue Pill pins at 100 kHz stand in for two I²C lines, each with 200 pF, one pulled up by 10 kΩ and one by 2.2 kΩ. Both fall sharply, but one rises slowly. Measure the rise time and the LOW level, and learn the range a pull-up must sit in.
en.description: Two Blue Pill pins set to PWM + open-drain (100 kHz) stand in for the I²C clock line. Bus A: 10 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 and 200 pF to GND; bus B: 2.2 kΩ pull-up and 200 pF. An open-drain pin can only pull down; going up, only the pull-up can charge the bus capacitance, so the rise time ≈ 2.2·R·C. Measure both rising edges, how high bus A gets at 400 kHz, and the LOW voltage and sink current, then choose pull-ups against the I²C spec.
compare: - **2.2 kΩ, 100 kHz**: τ = 440 ns, rise (10–90 %) = **0.97 µs** (2.2 × 2.2 kΩ × 200 pF = 0.97 µs), i.e. t_r(30–70 %) ≈ 373 ns: meets Standard mode, **fails** Fast mode (> 300 ns). The high level reaches 3.30 V. fall < 0.1 µs (limited by the time step; really about 2.2 × 40 Ω × 200 pF ≈ 18 ns).

- **10 kΩ, 100 kHz**: τ = 2 µs; half a period (5 µs) is only 2.5τ, so the high level only climbs to **3.03 V**. The scope's rise ≈ **3.3 µs** (measured on the actual swing; the full exponential is 4.4 µs), t_r(30–70 %) ≈ 1.7 µs — **not even Standard mode**.

- **400 kHz**: the half period is 1.25 µs. Bus A (10 kΩ) only reaches **1.54 V**, below the STM32's VIH (2.15 V) and I²C's 0.7·VDD (2.31 V): the other side always reads 0 and communication fails completely. Bus B (2.2 kΩ) reaches 3.11 V — it limps along, but its edges are out of spec.
- **Output LOW**: with 2.2 kΩ the sink current is 3.3 V / (2.2 kΩ + 40 Ω) ≈ **1.47 mA** and V_OL ≈ **59 mV**; with 10 kΩ only 0.33 mA.

measurements.ask: 100 kHz: bus B's (2.2 kΩ) rise time t_r (10% → 90%)
400 kHz: the highest voltage bus A (10 kΩ) reaches
measurements.explain: Half a period, 1.25 µs, is only about 0.6τ: it climbs to about 1.5 V — below the STM32's VIH (2.15 V), so the other side always reads 0.

measurements.ask: Both pins OUT LOW: multimeter, bus B (2.2 kΩ) to GND — the LOW level V_OL
measurements.explain: 3.3 V divided between 2.2 kΩ and the pin's switch of about 40 Ω: 3.3 × 40 / 2240 ≈ 59 mV, far below 0.4 V.

measurements.ask: From your reading, the current the pin sinks: (3.3 V − V_OL) / 2.2 kΩ
measurements.explain: ≈ 1.47 mA, within the 3 mA the chip promises. A pull-up down near 1 kΩ reaches that limit.

measurements.ask: I²C Fast mode needs t_r(30–70%) ≤ 300 ns (about ≤ 0.78 µs for 10–90%). From your readings:
choices: Only bus B (2.2 kΩ) meets it
measurements.explain: Bus B's 0.97 µs is above 0.78 µs too; at 200 pF Fast mode needs a pull-up ≤ 1.77 kΩ (use 1.5 kΩ).

hints: Each bus: pin → pull-up → 3V3, and the same pin → 200 pF → GND.
Bus A uses 10 kΩ, bus B 2.2 kΩ.
Set both pins to PWM, 100 kHz, 50 %, and tick Open-drain output.
tests: 100 kHz, bus B (2.2 kΩ): rise time meets Standard mode, reaches 3.3 V, fast fall
100 kHz, bus A (10 kΩ): too slow a rise, never reaches 3.3 V
400 kHz: bus A never reaches VIH
Open-drain LOW: both buses pulled down, sink currents within 3 mA
Released (open-drain HIGH): the pull-ups hold both lines at 3.3 V

cards.title: Which line looks like a shark fin?
text: Connect the **Blue Pill**'s bottom-row **3V3** and **GND** pins to the bottom rails. Pick two PWM-capable pins (e.g. **PB6**, **PB7**) as two "bus lines".
Bus A: pin → **`10 kΩ`** to 3V3, plus **`200 pF`** to GND. Bus B the same, but with a **`2.2 kΩ`** pull-up.
Set both pins to **PWM**, **`100 kHz`**, **`50 %`**, and tick **Open-drain output**. Scope CH1 on bus A, CH2 on bus B.
Both falling edges are steep. What about the rising edges? Which line looks like a shark fin?

cards.title: Going up, only the resistor helps
text: - An open-drain pin (from 5.6) can only **pull down**: inside is a switch of about 40 Ω to GND. To output HIGH it simply **lets go**.
![](fig:pullup)

- Once it lets go, only the pull-up can lift the line, and it must first charge the **bus capacitance**: every chip pin and every piece of wire adds a few pF. That is an RC charge — slow and curved. Pulling down goes through a few tens of ohms, so the falling edge is steep.
![](fig:edges)
- The 10 % → 90 % time of an RC charge (the scope's "rise time"):

- With 4.7 kΩ and 200 pF: $t_r ≈ 2.2 × 4700 × 200$ pF ≈ 2.07 µs. When half a clock period is much shorter than that, the line is pulled down again before it reaches HIGH, and the other chip always reads 0.

cards.title: Measure the rise time and the LOW level
text: - Press **Check my circuit**. The check also tries **400 kHz**, and both pins sitting still at **OUT LOW** and released.
- Read the rise time with the scope's **rise** measurement. For the 400 kHz question set both pins to 400 kHz in Properties and read bus A's highest voltage.
- For the two LOW-level questions set both pins to **OUT LOW** (open-drain still ticked) and measure bus B to GND with the multimeter. Predict first, then read.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **A pull-up has a window**: too large and the rise is too slow ($R ≤ \frac{t_r}{0.85 × C}$, using the spec's 30–70 % time); too small and the pin cannot pull the line down — chips only promise a LOW ≤ 0.4 V while sinking 3 mA, so on a 3.3 V bus R ≥ (3.3 − 0.4) / 3 mA ≈ 1 kΩ.
- Rules of thumb: 3.3 V, 100 kHz, a few modules: **2.2–4.7 kΩ**; 400 kHz or long wires: **1–2.2 kΩ**. The chip's internal pull-ups (about 40 kΩ) are too weak; a real bus needs external ones.
- A real-world catch: many I²C modules already carry 4.7 kΩ pull-ups; five of them in parallel make about 940 Ω, below the lower limit — remove the extras. Pull up to **3.3 V**, not 5 V.

tests.name: 100 kHz、总线 B（2.2 kΩ）：上升时间满足标准模式，到 3.3 V，下降很快
100 kHz、总线 A（10 kΩ）：上升太慢，高电平到不了 3.3 V
400 kHz：总线 A 爬不到 VIH
开漏输出低电平：两条总线都被拉低，灌电流在 3 mA 以内
松开（开漏输出高）：上拉把两条线都拉到 3.3 V

compare: - **10 kΩ，100 kHz**：τ = 2 µs，半个周期 5 µs 只有 2.5τ，高电平只爬到 **3.03 V**；示波器测的 rise ≈ **3.3 µs**（按实际摆幅算；完整指数曲线是 4.4 µs），t_r(30–70 %) ≈ 1.7 µs —— **连标准模式都不满足**。
- **400 kHz**：半周期 1.25 µs，10 kΩ 的总线 A 只爬到 **1.54 V**，低于 STM32 的 VIH（2.15 V）和 I²C 的 0.7·VDD（2.31 V），对方读到的永远是 0——通信完全失败；2.2 kΩ 的总线 B 爬到 3.11 V，勉强能用但边沿不合规。

measurements.ask: 100 kHz：总线 B（2.2 kΩ）的上升时间 t_r（10% → 90%）
400 kHz：总线 A（10 kΩ）能爬到的最高电压
measurements.explain: 半个周期 1.25 µs 只有约 0.6τ，只能爬到约 1.5 V——低于 STM32 的 VIH（2.15 V），对方永远读到 0。

measurements.ask: 两个引脚都「输出 低」：万用表测总线 B（2.2 kΩ）对 GND 的低电平 V_OL
measurements.explain: 3.3 V 被 2.2 kΩ 和引脚里约 40 Ω 的开关分压：3.3 × 40 / 2240 ≈ 59 mV，远低于 0.4 V。

measurements.ask: 用你的读数算引脚灌进去的电流：(3.3 V − V_OL) / 2.2 kΩ
measurements.explain: ≈ 1.47 mA，在芯片保证的 3 mA 以内。上拉小到约 1 kΩ 时就碰到这个上限。

choices: 只有 2.2 kΩ 的总线 B 满足
measurements.ask: I²C 快速模式要求 t_r(30–70%) ≤ 300 ns（约等于 10–90% 时间 ≤ 0.78 µs）。按你测的读数：
measurements.explain: 总线 B 的 0.97 µs 也超过了 0.78 µs；200 pF 时快速模式的上拉要 ≤ 1.77 kΩ（用 1.5 kΩ）。

hints: 每条总线：引脚 → 上拉电阻 → 3V3，同一个引脚再接 200 pF 电容到 GND。
总线 A 用 10 kΩ，总线 B 用 2.2 kΩ。
两个引脚都设成 PWM、100 kHz、50 %，并勾选「开漏输出」。
